TITLE: Spectral Prism Refraction
DESCRIPTION: Raymarches a faceted floating crystal octahedron over a dark obsidian mirror plane, splitting a sweeping white-cyan laser beam into a 7-band volumetric RGB dispersion fan with anisotropic floor caustics and planar crystal reflections. Visually special for its per-channel RGB internal refraction sparkle and crisp Pink-Floyd-meets-optics caustic projections. Controls: speed (crystal & laser sweep speed), intensity (HDR bloom), dispersion (spectral fan spread & IOR separation), invert (negative mode), hue_shift (spectrum offset), beam_angle XY (camera orbit & elevation).
